mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Slaying Baron Nashor has empowered Jax.

Jax gained @Spell.JaxPassive:BelvethVsJaxQuestRewardStacks@ stacks of Bel'Veth's passive, Death in Lavender and gains an additional @Spell.JaxPassive:BelvethVsJaxQuestRewardStacks@ stacks each time he slays Bel'Veth or assists in her defeat.

Attack Speed per Stack: @Spell.JaxPassive:BelvethVsJaxQuestRewardAttackSpeedPerStack@
Bonus Attack Speed: @Spell.JaxPassive:BelvethVsJaxQuestRewardAttackSpeed@

“Baron, Bel'Veth—hah! No one's takin' this world, not now, not ever.”

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Grandmaster-at-Arms</titleLeft><mainText>Jax's next attack deals bonus Magic Damage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Rare Fish Get!</titleLeft><mainText>This unit caught a rare fish!</mainText>

mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Jax must prevent Bel'Veth from consuming the world, starting with Baron Nashor. Contributing to taking down Baron Nashor empowers Jax in his fight against the Void.

“Great. If the Void Empress eats this place, where am I meant to fish!?”
Jax did not slay Baron Nashor, preventing him from reaching his true strength.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Jax's combat prowess allows him to dodge all incoming attacks for a short duration and then quickly counterattack, stunning all surrounding enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Jax enters a defensive stance for up to @DodgeDuration@ seconds, dodging incoming Attacks and taking @AoEDamageReduction@% less damage from area of effect Abilities. After @DodgeDuration@ seconds or Recasting, Jax deals @TotalDamage@ + @PercentHealthDamage@% max Health magic damage and Stuns nearby enemies for @StunDuration@ second.

The damage is increased by @PercentIncreasedPerDodge*100@% per Attack dodged, up to a maximum of @MaxDamage@ + @MaxPercentHealthDamage@% max Health.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Relentless Assault</titleLeft><mainText>Jax's basic attacks increase his Attack Speed by <font color='#FFFFFF'>@f1@%</font> for 2.5 seconds. This effect stacks up to 8 times and the stacks fall off one at a time.</mainText>

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Jax's Attacks grant a stack for 2.5 seconds that gives him <attackSpeed>@AttackSpeedPerStack@ Attack Speed</attackSpeed> (max <attackSpeed>@MaxBonusAttackSpeed@ Attack Speed</attackSpeed>).

mLocKeys.keySummary: Jax leaps toward a unit. If they are an enemy, he strikes them with his weapon.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Jax leaps to a friendly or enemy unit or ward, dealing <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> if it is an enemy.
This unit has increased Armor and Magic Resist

mLocKeys.keySummary: Every third consecutive attack deals additional Magic Damage. Additionally, Jax can activate this ability to deal damage around himself and strengthen his resolve, increasing his Armor and Magic Resist for a short duration.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Every third Attack within @PassiveFallOffTime@ seconds deals an additional @OnHitDamage@ magic damage.

Active: Jax slams his lantern down, dealing @SwingDamageTotal@ magic damage to nearby enemies. If he hits a champion he gains @BaseArmor@ Armor and @BaseMR@ Magic Resist plus @BonusArmor@ Armor and @BonusMR@ Magic Resist per additional champion hit for @Duration@ seconds. During this time every second Attack deals additional magic damage instead of every third.
Jax charges his weapon with energy, causing his next attack to deal additional damage.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Jax charges his weapon with energy, causing his next attack to deal additional damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Jax charges his weapon with energy, causing his next Attack or <spellName>Leap Strike</spellName> to deal an additional <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.
